segments.translation: Then one day, while he was doing something of this sort outside, and his companions went to the town, to the church, as they often did, and the bishop, alone in the oratory, was occupied either in reading books or in prayers, he suddenly heard, as he later said afterwards, the sweetest and most beautiful voice of people singing and rejoicing descend from heaven to earth.

He said that he first heard the voice and the song from the southeastern part of the sky, that is, from the height of the winter sunrise; and they gradually approached him until it came to the roof of the oratory in which the bishop was. Entering, it filled everything and surrounded it all around.
And he then carefully directed his attention to the things that he heard.

Then, about half an hour later, he heard the same song of joy rise again from the roof of the same oratory, and return upwards to heaven along the very way by which it had come, with indescribable sweetness.
Then he remained there for a while, wondering and amazed; and with an attentive mind he considered and pondered what those things might mean.
Then the bishop opened the window of the oratory and made a signal with his hand, as was his custom if anyone was outside, for him to come in to him. Then he immediately went in to him.
He, the bishop, said to him: “Go quickly to the church and tell our seven brothers to come here to me; and you too be with them.”

cruxes.finding: The singular hē is the song, explicitly Cook note 9a. It is not Owini walking to the roof.
Plural agreement with the voice and song. Preserve this alongside singular song-reference at becōm.
Accusative objects of the embedded gehīerde, not nominative subjects of cwæð. Cook note8.
Earlier occurrences in the selected span describe Chad’s oratory; the companions and the closing summons refer to the community church. The same lexeme does not force a single building.
An interval of about half an hour; the timing is from the preceding music event. It is not a measured half-season.

cruxes.anchor: 153.5–6 ðæt hē in tō him ēode
cruxes.finding: Content/purpose of the signal; first hē is Owini, him Chad. No absent continuation should be imported.
